summary: Iteration 15 tested: COD only for pickup (pengiriman kurir wajib bayar online), auto-cancel of COD pickup orders after 2x24 jam with manual extend, and the 'Siap Diambil' flow. Backend: 11 of 11 feature tests pass (tests/test_pgs_iter15_cod_pickup_expiry.py, run serially with -n 0). One new bug is confirmed by tests/test_pgs_iter15_voucher_leak.py (2 of 2 fail): when checkout is rejected with COD + courier or Midtrans not ready, the voucher quota is still used up. Frontend (375x667): all requested flows pass. Checkout: COD is shown and selected for pickup with the 2x24 jam note. Choosing JNE hides COD and shows co-online-required; pressing pay shows the error bar. Picking a destination (Patrang) keeps pickup selected. Seller detail: so-expires and so-extend-24/48 work (date moved +24h, then +48h). Proses Pesanan, then so-ready, then so-ready-info, then so-complete gives 'Selesai'. Buyer: order-pickup-card shows the store name; order-expires shows while status is cod; order-ready shows after ready. Notifications 'Pesanan siap diambil' and 'Batas waktu pesanan diperpanjang' are delivered. No deprecated Expo packages found.

critical.issue: Voucher quota leak. The voucher is claimed (vouchers.used +1, server.py:840) before 3 checks that can reject the order: saldo insufficient (lines 851-855), online payment not ready (line 856-857) and COD + courier (line 858-859). None of these give the voucher use back. Reproduced with a TEST voucher: after COD+JNE and Midtrans+JNE were both rejected with 400, used was 2. Every buyer who tries delivery with a voucher while Midtrans is off uses up quota.

issues: The COD option sub-text still says 'Bayar tunai saat barang diterima'. COD is now pickup-only, so it should say something like 'Bayar tunai saat ambil di toko'.
The CTA says 'Bayar Sekarang' even for COD pickup ('Buat Pesanan' fits better).
With a delivery courier selected and no online payment available, the pay button stays enabled. It only shows the error after tapping; it could be disabled instead.
Pickup orders still show 'No. resi: belum ada' in the tracking card.
The seller detail shows the card label 'Kirim ke' for pickup orders; 'Pembeli' / 'Diambil oleh' would be clearer.
When auth is missing, the raw English error 'Not authenticated' is shown (not Indonesian).

action_items: HIGH: In POST /api/checkout (server.py), either move the online-not-ready, COD-courier and saldo checks (lines 847-859) before the voucher claim at line 840, or give the voucher use back ($inc used -1) before each of those HTTPExceptions. Then re-run tests/test_pgs_iter15_voucher_leak.py.

Optional: the frontend useEffect in checkout.tsx (line 110) switches the method from cod to midtrans only. If only Xendit is ready, a delivery order keeps method 'cod' and the backend rejects it with 400. Fall back to xendit when midtrans is not ready.
Older suites that expect COD + courier orders now fail by design (e.g. test_pgs_iter8_cod_shipping.py, iter7/iter9 _order helpers using a courier with cod). Update them to use pickup or saldo.
Minor UX text fixes listed in design_issues.
critical_code_review_comments: expire_cod_orders: the conditional update on status 'cod' prevents a race with the seller processing the order. Restock, voucher and saldo are returned through _release_voucher, which is idempotent through restock_once/return_balance_once. Good.
The extend endpoint uses max(current, now) + hours, is limited to the order's store, accepts hours 1-168 (pydantic), and rejects non-cod orders with 400. Verified.
The ready endpoint is idempotent (it returns the existing ready_at without a duplicate history entry or notification). Verified.
The pytest suite shares stock counters on pgs-9955, so run it with '-n 0'. pytest.ini enables xdist by default, and parallel workers make the stock assertions flaky.

rca_of_issue: Voucher leak: checkout() claims the voucher atomically (find_one_and_update $inc used) before the payment-method validations. The HTTPException raised at lines 852/855/857/859 skips the compensating $inc -1 that only exists in the payment-creation except block (line 894).
